title: Emberline
description: Shapes, silhouettes and a language of heat for a world at the edge of collapse.
lede: Shapes, silhouettes and a language of heat for a world at the edge of collapse.
mainText: Emberline began with a question: how can a landscape communicate danger before a single character appears? I explored compressed compositions, hot colour accents and heavy atmospheric perspective to make the environment feel active and unstable.
